findings.title: On Booking.com a visitor cannot reach the hotel until after they have booked
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Opening 'Contacting the Property' on the Booking.com page says a specific request can be made only after selecting a rate, and the hotel's contact details are given only after booking; the page carries no phone, email or WhatsApp link.

value: scroll to the end of the property section

findings.playbook_ref: §2 'How do I book, and how fast will they answer?'; §3 item 9 contact block
findings.fix_in_new_site: contact.phone (+94764832988, from the Google listing) shown as a tel: link in the contact block repeated in the footer (playbook §3 item 9), beside bookingLinks[]

findings.title: Every booking the hotel receives online goes through an OTA; Booking.com's page says this property pays it a higher commission
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: A visitor who wants to book direct finds no website, no email and no WhatsApp; the Booking.com page's 'Preferred Partner Program' section says the property is in the Preferred Plus Program and 'It'll pay us a higher commission if you make a booking.'
findings.fix_in_new_site: the site itself: bookingLinks[] to the Booking.com and Agoda listings plus contact.phone, so a visitor who finds the hotel's own page has a way to reach it that is not only an OTA; no commission rate is claimed (none stated on any page fetched)

findings.title: The first phone screen of the Booking.com page is half cookie dialog and app banner; the hotel photo is covered
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On a 390x844 phone screen the Booking.com page opens with an app-install banner, Booking's own header and a 'Manage cookie settings' dialog over the lower half, so the hotel's photo is cut off and the 'Check availability' button is not on the first screen.
findings.playbook_ref: §3 item 1 first screen; §4 'Nothing may cover the content or the booking action on load'
findings.fix_in_new_site: playbook §3 first screen: businessName + what and where, ratings[] (booking 9.3/10, 34, with capturedAt), the primary bookingLinks[0] action above the fold; no cookie wall (playbook §4)

findings.title: The Agoda listing opens on a phone with an app interstitial over a placeholder image and no hotel name
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Opening the Agoda link on a phone shows 'We have even lower prices in our app!' over a grey placeholder building and a 'Make an online reservation' date box; the hotel's name and photos are not on that screen.
findings.fix_in_new_site: bookingLinks[] order: Booking.com first (dossier booking.engine_url), Agoda second, each label naming the platform

findings.title: The Google listing, the entry point from Maps, has no website link
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: A traveller who finds the hotel on Google Maps can call or get directions, but there is no website to see rooms or photos; they have to search an OTA separately (as recorded by the harvester on 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-23; this audit could not re-open the listing, see not_measurable).
findings.playbook_ref: §1 the customer finds it on Google Maps

findings.title: Two house numbers and two names across the listings
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Booking.com shows '166/2 Welhengoda Road , Ahangama' under the name 'The Lavish Haven - Ahangama'; the Google listing says 'No166/1 walhengoda road' under 'The Lavish Haven Hotel And Resort', so a visitor comparing the two may wonder whether they are the same place.
findings.playbook_ref: §6 address is the Google listing address
findings.fix_in_new_site: contact.address from the Google listing per playbook §6; businessName as the dossier's business.name

recommended.primary_label: Check dates and prices on Booking.com
recommended.offer_framing: rooms[] with beds and sleeps, amenities[] (pool, restaurant, breakfast), then bookingLinks[] to live dates; no nightly number (schema: live prices are not content)

off_site.advice: add the new site URL to the listing
use one name across the listings
confirm the right house number and correct the other listing

recommended.closing_intent: send the reader to live dates and name the listings

not_measurable: Google Maps listing: headless load at 390x844 stopped at Google's 'Before you continue' consent page (funnel/google-fold.png); not bypassed. Listing facts are the harvester's of 2026-09-23
TripAdvisor listing: HTTP 403 to headless Chromium (funnel/tripadvisor-fold.png)
Agoda listing content beyond the first screen: the page rendered an app interstitial and no property content (funnel/agoda-fold.png, 716 characters of text)
Google search results page for the business name: not attempted (same consent wall as Maps)
Commission rate: no rate stated on any page fetched; partner.booking.com commission help page returned HTTP 403. Only Booking.com's own sentence 'It'll pay us a higher commission' is quoted (F2)
Booking.com engine beyond the property page: dates not entered, no rate selected, no booking started (hard constraint 10)
Whether the owner answers the Google-listed phone, and reply time: no contact in test mode
